summary: Skillsoft Corp. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Sale and Purchase Agreement to sell all interests in Global Knowledge Training LLC to EHJob GP LLC for up to $20M total consideration: $10M initial (funded via cash, seller note, or third-party financing) plus $10M deferred in five quarterly installments starting nine months post-close, net of ~$2M employee liabilities. The seller note secured by cash/AR; deferred consideration secured by IP. Proceeds for general corporate purposes. Board recommendation not stated; no advisor named. Conditions: customary including regulatory; expected close Q2. Watch: collectability risk given purchaser financing dependency and compensation structure.
